WHEREAs, Wyoming Statute 15-7-401 provides for a Boardof
Public Utilities(BOARD)to manage，operate，maintainand
control municipal waterworks, a sanitary sewer system and sewage
disposal plants; and
WHEREAS, Cheyenne City Code Section 2.68.010 established
such a BOARD to have exclusive authority to manage， operate,
maintain and control the Cheyenne Municipal Waterworks, Sanitary
Sewer System and Sewage Disposal Plants of the City and to make
all rules and regulations necessary for the safe, economical and
efficient operation and maintenance of the above facilities; and
WHEREAS, the2013Water and Wastewater Master Plan
recommends the construction of a Powdered Activated Carbon Feed
System atthe RL She rard Water Treatment Plant to remove taste
and odor causing compounds; and
WHEREAS，the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne (CITY)
recognizes the2013Water and Wastewater Master Plan as an
essential planning tool andthe necessity for the construction
of a Powdered Activated Carbon Feed System at the RL She rard
compounds（PROJECT); and
WHEREAS， the PROJECT includes， but is not limited to，the
engineering and construction of a feed system and pipeline to
deliver the powdered activated carbon to an injection point
where it will be introduced into the water treatment process;
and
WHEREAS，the cost of the PROJECT is estimated at
$1,089,800; and
WHEREAs，aloanfrom the Wyoming Drinking Water State
principal forgiveness, which is estimated to be $272,450 for the
amendedloan; and
WHEREAS，a loan from the Wyoming Drinking Water State
Revolving Fund is subject to a loan origination fee of 0.5
percent， which is estimated to be $5,449 for the amended loan;
and
WHEREAS，the CITY and the BOARD recognize that the annual
principal and interest payment on the proposed amended loan,
after principal forgiveness, will be approximately $52,430.66,
assuming a loan term of 20 years at 2.5%, and that the CITY and
the BOARD anticipate an early payoff of the loan; and
WHEREAS，the CITY and the BOARD are committed to repaying
the loan from revenue from the Water Enterprise Fund; and
